title: HeyGen launch template 03-message-sting
what_it_does: 12.8 s square: tiles flip into a chat, a request is sent, a card is docked, a store listing grows, status rows pass.

why: Apache-2.0 composition source by HeyGen, built to be re-branded (720x720). Copy only index.html, README and ledger; do not copy the HeyGen logo and wordmark SVGs (NOTICE excludes brand assets from the licence).
